verdict.rationale: Calendly ships its own AI assistant (Callie), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Calendly's own MCP server, which exposes Calendly tools to outside AI apps. That is the server role and earns no credit for this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Calendly or Callie connecting to user-supplied MCP servers.
